scope: Development only, public SEC-disclosed issuer Chapter 7/11 outcome. Original final and historical training reservations excluded. Missing outcomes never become negatives.
sampling: Sample all primary 2023/early-2024 SEC Item 1.03 proxies and an independent fixed 10% background among remaining 2022 nonfinancial annual filers. Marginal inclusion accounts for original sampling, complementary final selection and historical selection. Reweight original development rows by the same union formula.
